summary.result: Results of this study showed that water loss ratio in lateral canals was bigger than that of main canal unlike current design standard and the loss decrease as flow increase.
summary.background: Water losses in irrigation canals are mainly estimated as the sum of conveyance and delivery water loss.
summary.method: The measurement was performed by canal type, size and designed flow using the inflow-outflow method at a major points such as start and end of each canal, derivation point of canal and inlet of paddy fields.
